starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.text: You search through the notice board...

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.player: 'Damaged roof tiles for sale'... 'Come on down to Bob's Axes'... 'Contributions welcomed to Ned's New-Window Fund'...

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.text: 'Keen fighter sought to deal with troublesome monster. Reward offered. Speak to Sarah at the South Falador Farm for details.'

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.player: This could be worth looking into.

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board.prompt: Start the A Porcine of Interest quest?

steps.player: Right, let's go and see what Sarah has in mind.

starting-out-searching-the-notice-board-.text: You search through the notice board but find nothing more of interest.

starting-out-talking-to-sarah-initial-co.speaker: Sarah
starting-out-talking-to-sarah-initial-co.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: I've come about the bounty.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!

steps.player: Can you explain what happened?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.

steps.player: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!

options.text: What did the monster look like?

steps.player: What did this monster look like?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.player: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.

steps.player: Ok, yes that could work.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: Whereabouts were you attacked again?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.

steps.player: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.player: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.

starting-out-talking-to-sarah-subsequent.speaker: Sarah
starting-out-talking-to-sarah-subsequent.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: What did the monster look like?
Any tips on finding this thing?
I think that'll be all for now.

investigating-the-crossroads-damaged-car.text: It seems as though the monster was trying to run off with some of Sarah's produce. From the looks of things, it was heading north-east.

investigating-the-crossroads-cabbages.text: The cabbage is damaged and has begun to yellow.

investigating-the-crossroads-carrots.text: The carrot has been slightly gnawed on.

investigating-the-crossroads-carrots.player: Weird... What sort of monster charges at someone and then steals a bunch of carrots?

investigating-the-crossroads-potatoes.text: These potatoes seem to have been largely untouched.

investigating-the-crossroads-potatoes.player: Would you look at that... Apparently our monster is picky.

investigating-the-crossroads-broken-dead.player: Something pretty big must have come running through here to knock this over.

investigating-the-crossroads-strange-hol.text: If the player does not have a rope in their inventory:

steps.player: This looks like the place. It's a long way down, though... I'll need to tie something onto the edge.

investigating-the-crossroads-strange-hol.text: If the player has a rope in their inventory:

steps.text: You tie the rope tightly around a protruding rock.

inside-the-cave-investigating-pile-of-ro.player: Huh... there's a rope already down here. I hope noone else has got to this monster first.

inside-the-cave-talking-to-sarah-after-f.speaker: Sarah
inside-the-cave-talking-to-sarah-after-f.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh it's you, my monster slayer! How goes the quest?

steps.player: I'm still working on it... I've managed to find its lair though.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Sounds like you're making progress. Take care!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: The skeleton seems fresh. It looks like the bones have been gnawed clean fairly recently.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.player: There's also a scrawled note. It's barely readable...

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: A level 37 Pig Thing appears behind the player.
The Pig Thing sprays acid at the player.
If the player is not wearing Gnome goggles:

steps.player: Argh! My eyes!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: If the player is wearing Gnome goggles:

steps.player: Argh! My eyes! The goggles do nothing!

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: Well then, what do we have here?
Spria approaches the player's unconscious body.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: Seems I came at just the right time.

inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.speaker: Spria
inside-the-cave-investigating-the-skelet.text: We'd better get you out of here before that thing returns.
The player wakes up in Spria's house in Draynor Village

inside-the-cave-attempting-to-enter-the-.player: I think I find out more about that monster from Spria in Draynor Village before heading back down there.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: Who are you? How did I end up here?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: My name's Spria and I'm a slayer master. You've had a nasty encounter with a Sourhog.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: A Sourhog? You mean the giant pig monster?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: Precisely. You're extremely lucky that I found you. Another few hours and you'd have been hog chow.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: Were you responding to Sarah's bounty too?

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: Yes... It sounded like an easy few coins...

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.speaker: Spria
the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: I thought as much. I found you on the floor of the cave, you must have been knocked unconscious.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.player: That thing caught me completely off-guard. Normally I can handle myself in a fight, but its spitting attack is pretty fearsome!

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I have an item for you that will help you on your quest, but you don't seem to have enough space. Come and see me again when you've cleared some room.

the-sourhog-talking-to-spria-initial-con.text: If the player's inventory is not full:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The beast's saliva is extremely acidic and your eyes are most vulnerable. It'll cause terrible injuries and leave you unable to attack or defend yourself very well.

steps.player: So how am I supposed to handle that?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Luckily, the Slayer skill provides us with an array of useful equipment and techniques for dealing with... special foes.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: In the case of our Sourhog, you'll be needing these.
Spria hands you a pair of Reinforced Goggles.
Reinforced goggles

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: This eyewear will protect you from the spitting attack, allowing you to fight the monster on equal terms.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Most enemies have a weakness, too. The Sourhog's thick hide provides excellent protection against slashing and insulates it from magic damage.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: You'd be best trying to pierce it with arrows or a stabbing weapon.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Go now, the bounty is all yours to claim. I suggest you recoup your strength and head back to fight it using your new goggles.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: If you make it out alive, collect your bounty and then come see me so that we can speak further.

steps.player: Why are you helping me?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well, I suppose I could have left you in there to be eaten...

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: But you know what that'd make me? A monster. And as a slayer master, that's really not a great look.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Besides, my father always taught me that knowledge is worth more than gold. I'm happy to sacrifice a few coins in order to pass my experience on to you.

steps.player: Well, I sure am glad you were there to lend a hand. Thank you!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Don't mention it. Was there something else?

options.text: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?

steps.player: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I carried you out and dragged you back here to my house to recover, it really wasn't easy. You're welcome to rest here for as long as you need.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: You said you were a slayer master. What's that?

steps.player: You said you were a slayer master. What's that?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: There are many of us. We're experts in the ancient art of monster slaying. People from across Gielinor come to us for tasks and advice.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well... actually, I'm fairly new to this. I've been learning from my father, Turael, for many years. We decided it was finally time for me to continue the family profession.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?

steps.player: Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?

steps.text: If the player has a pair equipped:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: No, you're still wearing the last pair I gave you!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If the player has a pair in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: You've still got the last one I gave you, it's there in your inventory! Those things aren't cheap, you know.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If the player has a pair in their bank:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I know many people all across Gielinor, and my sources tell me you still have the last one in your bank.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?
If a player does not have a pair in their inventory or bank:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Sure, I have another going spare. Please try to take better care of these.
"Spria hands you another pair of Reinforced Goggles."

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.text: What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Well, I'm not much of a history buff... But I'll tell you what I know.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Many years back, before even I was around, there were two rival family farms not far from where we're standing.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Every year the village would hold a 'Finest Swine in Show' prize at the annual faire.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The same farmer would win year after year without fail. Driven mad with jealousy, his rival decided to hire a dodgy dark wizard to give him an edge over the competition.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: The wizard attempted to alter the pig's appearance. I'm sure you can guess how well that went!

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Long story short, the mutant, what we now know as a Sourhog, went on a brief rampage and escaped.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: It must have somehow managed to reproduce, because people have reported seeing them in groups.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Up until now, so long as they were left alone, they'd keep to themselves. Rumours are, they live in deep underground caverns, scavenging what they can find.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: But if they're living so close-by and attacking people on roads, then... they must be getting bold and trying to resurface.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Was there something else?

options.condition: If the player has gone through any of the above choices:

steps.player: That'll be all for now.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Very well. Good luck, slayer.

options.text: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?
You said you were a slayer master. What's that?
Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?
What can you tell me about the Sourhog?

the-sourhog-attempting-to-enter-the-hole.player: I don't want to go back down there without wearing the right equipment!

the-sourhog-climbing-the-blockage.player: I don't think Spria will be rescuing me this time. If I go in there, I'm fighting this thing to the death!

steps.text: The player climbs over the blockage.

the-sourhog-attempting-to-climb-the-rope.player: Before I leave, I should go and collect a foot from that dead Sourhog as proof of my kill.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player doesn't have a knife or slash weapon:

steps.text: You try to pull a foot off with your bare hands, but to no avail.

steps.player: Perhaps I should go and get something sharp.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player uses something other than a knife or slash weapon:

steps.player: I don't think that's sharp enough to cut a foot off...

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player has a knife or slash weapon:

steps.text: You slice a foot off and place it inside your backpack.

the-sourhog-taking-the-sourhog-s-foot.text: If the player has a Sourhog foot in their inventory:

steps.player: I've already collected a foot from this thing. I should take it to Sarah.

the-sourhog-attempting-to-re-enter-the-s.player: I don't need to go back down there right now. I should take the foot to Sarah and collect my reward.

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.player: I did it! I killed the Sourhog!

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: Nicely done. Did you collect your reward from Sarah?

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-spria.text: Go and collect your reward and then come and speak with me.

collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-sarah.speaker: Sarah
collecting-the-bounty-talking-to-sarah.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
If the player doesn't have the sourhog foot:

steps.player: I guess I'll go and get you some proof.

steps.text: If the player has the sourhog foot:

steps.player: How about this as proof?

steps.text: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!

steps.player: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I'll probably just give it to the dog.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.

steps.player: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.

finishing-up-talking-to-sarah-before-tel.speaker: Sarah
finishing-up-talking-to-sarah-before-tel.text: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: Feeling better now that the monster's gone?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Very much so! Thanks again. What was it, anyway?

steps.player: It was a Sourhog. A giant bipedal pig creature!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Oh crumbs... I think I've heard of those... My grandfather was always rambling on about them.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Nevermind... that's all history now. Weren't you heading off to see Spria?

steps.player: Yes, I suppose I should get going.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.text: Safe travels!

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.player: I did it! I killed the Sourhog and collected the bounty from Sarah.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: Very impressive, slayer. I'm glad that the goggles served you well.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: Although, these Sourhogs often live in primitive tribes. I fear that where there's one, there's likely to be more to follow.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.speaker: Spria
finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: We may have to monitor that lair from time to time to keep their population in check.
If the player has unlocked the ability to craft the slayer helmet:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: I've noticed that you've unlocked the ability to craft slayer helms. From now on, when assembling one, fasten a pair of Reinforced Goggles to the eye holes to gain their benefit.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: While we're on the topic, I can upgrade any of your existing slayer helms now.
The screen briefly fades to black

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: That should do the trick.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: If the player does not have a slayer task:

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: By the way, you seem to have a natural talent for killing monsters. Would you like a new slayer task now?

steps.prompt: Do you want a slayer task from Spria?

steps.text: Player receives a Slayer task.

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: Very well, come back if you change your mind.

finishing-up-talking-to-spria.text: If the player has a slayer task:
